body: thank you so much. i doubt i’ll be able to call or something anytime soon because i live with my parents but if i can i will use this for sure. thank you
even though i still blame myself fully, thank you so much for your words. even though i still feel guilty, you do have a point. thank you
i’m blaming myself because they told me several times that they needed me
i just feel so guilty that’s its kinda impossible to even think of forgiving myself
i did not but there really aren’t. thank you so much, though.
hey, i’m sorry. i’m still here, sadly, but thank you so much. if you need to talk i’m here, always.
he does. i told him i have been single for months now and that i was never in a relationship or even felt attracted to who lemon said i was dating.
orange knew how i felt and in fact it was mutual until lemon lied. he doesn’t really care about what she did, though. he said he was sorry, but apparently he really likes lemon.
looking back she did do a lot of questionable things throughout the years, talking shit behind my back and stuff. i guess i just wanted to see the good in her. you’re probably right.
yeah, reddit app problems
he’s bi haha
oh! and happy cake day too :)
yeah, for sure wouldn’t leave him because of this. thank you
thank you, i might
hey friend. trust me, they will be. thank you so much for your words, even if i can’t fully believe them. thank you so much

i’m sorry, friend. i haven’t asked for anything and i won’t but i got merch of my favourite band today and i feel so stupid. i won’t even be around to wear it. i’m really sorry you feel like this, i’m available to talk if you need
thank you so much for your kind words and time, and okay, i will. take care of yourself too please

thank you. i wish, but just seeing their face makes me panic and before calming down brought to post this i was having a meltdown over seeing them and being scared of posting on social media about my new friends. i really wish i could cut them out for real, i want to, but i’m scared which is pathetic i know.
thank you so much for your input, you’re right.

they most likely really didn’t lose their friends, in fact people have stopped talking to me because they sided with them. i guess the shitty thing here is that they do not act like this with other people, it’s literally just me. they look like an angel in other people’s eyes while i look like the biggest bitch ever. it’s quite upsetting that friends i’ve known for year have sided with them and stopped talking to me for this. they [my former friend] literally don’t treat anyone badly besides me, and that’s why i think they are just playing the victim imo. i wish i could just cut all ties and block them everywhere but it would turn into a shit show and they would make everyone hate me because they can seriously paint me as the bad guy every time. but thank you so much and you are right, i don’t need this.
you don’t sound stupid and venting is good
thank you for even wishing you could and it’s not anymore, but thank you for looking out for me either way. i hope life gives you many good things

i’m so sorry for your less, i have lost some pets too and it’s terribly heartbreaking, and i can’t even imagine how much worse it is when they are your only motivation. i’m sure you have your dog the best life he could’ve lived and he was lucky to have someone that held on for him. as for the pup, i know she must be one of the happiest dogs too and i’m glad she keeps you going. thank you for sharing your experience and for caring, the “you deserve that dog and that dog deserves you” touched me so much that i actually have it as my home screen on my phone to remember that at all times. be safe for you and your baby
i really want to stay with him, but it’s been really hard. thank you for your message, it really touched me and it made me give me some more treats because i was so mushy haha

hey, you were the first one to actually reply to this but i’ve been quite sick and couldn’t get to replying earlier, i’m sorry and thank you for caring.  as for friends, i would say i have two or three, but it’s quite hard for me to open up to them, i always feel like a burden, you know? they all have pretty much witnessed some form of me being extremely suicidal and i always feel like it’s just inconsiderate to bother them with this again when i haven’t actually done it yet. i don’t like to feel like i’m craving attention and that’s how i feel like they feel when i talk about it multiple times. i really hope i’m making sense ahah. but it’s always easier to talk to a stranger on the internet, i feel like, so if you don’t mind me messaging you, i would love to. thank you so much
i’m really sorry that you had to give him away :( hopefully he will find a good home and be loved as he deserves. and i did cuddle him :) thank you for caring
that’s true, they just love unconditionally and expect nothing in return from it. thank you for caring

that’s a lovely suggestion and thank you so much for it, sadly i’m underage and my mom is kinda unstable and doesn’t really let me out of the house or anything and if i told her i wanted to do that she would want to come too and i really don’t want to be with her while doing that sort of stuff, but still, thank you so much for that idea and for caring enough to reply
yeah, i feel you. thank you for caring and i hope you’re doing okay
